I'd like to share my personal experience to help others make an informed decision before seeking treatment.
I experienced severe pain and inflammation after getting braces, to the point where I had to ask the clinic if I should go to the hospital because of constant bleeding. However, I received a short, indifferent response, and they simply recommended extraction without any further examination or explanation of the cause.

In the chat, they even responded, "It wouldn't be any cheaper than this 😁," which felt inappropriate given my anxiety and pain.
When I asked for reasons or alternative options, I only received:

"It has to be extracted, otherwise it will continue like this."
There was no further advice, no assessment based on images, no attempt to explain why, or whether there were other treatment options before extraction.

This type of communication made me feel neglected, uninformed, and extremely uncomfortable.
I want those looking for a clinic to consider this carefully, and I hope the clinic will improve its approach to answering patient questions, providing more appropriate information, and respecting patients' concerns.
